مَسْمُورٌ Nailed; made fast, firm, or strong, with a nail [or nails]. (S, * Mgh.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A man, (TA,) having little flesh, strongly knit in the bones and sinews. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- And, with ة, (tropical:) A woman, (M,) or girl, or young woman, (A, O, K,) compact, or firm, in body, (M, A, O, K,) not flabby in flesh. (M, O, K.) ＝
-A2- عَيْشٌ مَسْمُورٌ (tropical:) A turbid life: (M, O, * K, * TA:) from سَمَارٌ applied to milk. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
